blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to K-12 & School Systems. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

School systems serve every child under public scrutiny: learning analytics, special-education compliance, safeguarding and parental communication. Technology must be privacy-strict (minors), accessibility-complete and teacher-time-respecting.

items: Assessment, attendance and wellbeing data siloed; interventions late.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Decision Intelligence Systems, Process & Task Mining, Decision Intelligence Systems from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Learning analytics, Safeguarding case management, Special-ed compliance) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — FERPA/GDPR-K among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end: extraction, validation and downstream action.
See the work as it actually runs: event-log truth before you automate anything.
One automation spine: APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Education & Research level this capability reads as: early-warning signals trigger advising interventions with case management (retention lift in targeted cohorts). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
